content.content: Love the G-class content. I have driven both the w461 and the newer W464s i have to say that both have extremely good off-roading capabilities. I understand the hate of the new class of cars being known for only being pavement princesses but Mercedes haven't thrown the offroad heritage into the bin. The g63 and g500s are still great offroading cars but with more comforts and if you are not afraid to scratch the paint of a +170k new g class you will still find that they are great for off-roading. they have more creature comforts that the "purists" take and think that its nothing like the old W460 and W461s. Yes they are wider, softer edges and more computers but they are still great for offroading if you are ready to pay the California pavement princess premium.  All this coming from a former W463 G500 owner.
